entries.name: gpe_rt.metallib
entries.role: GPU driver support shaders for Apple silicon / Apple GL-over-Metal
entries.note: Apple GPU driver internals (AGX family, GL shim); BifrOSt gets GPU drivers from Mesa/Vulkan (springboard/gpu) so there is no equivalent and no app depends on it

entries.name: ImageFilters.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has no on-device vision/ML image pipeline (only CPU guided filter, histogram and subject-lift models); needed for Photos edits, portrait/depth effects and image analysis. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: Gess_Kernels.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has 3D models (springboard/ui/src/scene3d.rs, scene_material.rs, mesh.rs, particle_system3d.rs) that draw nothing, and no 3D rasteriser or PBR shader; needed for 3D previews (Quick Look USD) and any 3D app. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: harpe.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: Materials, lights and mesh layout exist as models, but no GPU rasteriser or physically based shader draws them yet.
